author: smcarus
title: What will India's 2026 inflation be, as the IMF first reports it after the year?
summary: Forecast IMF WEO average consumer price inflation for India for 2026, in percent, as first read on or after 1 May 2027.
knownLimits: The IMF reports India on a fiscal-year basis (April to March) for some series; the WEO figure as published is used.
